note: A static if generate choosing between two implementations. Used to fail, on hif-backend#86: hif2verilog printed the generate condition as a bare prefix before the always keyword and emitted both branches unconditionally, producing output that does not parse. It now prints `generate if (cond) begin : name ... end endgenerate`. hif2vhdl still aborts on the same input (the other half of #86), which this design's pipeline does not exercise. hif-backend#78 covers the for generate half and recorded if generate as unaffected - it was not, and this design is what said so.
